page.notes: The text at the foot of the page is cut at the catchword "defi-", which is the first part of the word "desiderata" continued on the next page. The note "tom 3 p. 575." is placed as printed beside the line with "Deus" and "omnes". The superscript "tom" beside "Deus" is read as "tom" with some doubt. The word "Vafquezii" is read from the italic type; its letter forms are not fully clear.
